title: 분광 손실 계수(λ)와 2배 거친 쌍 계수(c) 탐색: K2D 학습법, W2 2×2 합성곱 구현
hypothesis: Changing the spectral-loss weight lambda (now 0.46) and the 2x-coarse-pair weight c (now 1.0) shifts the balance between SAM and PSNR and between the original and coarse scales; a common (lambda, c) for QB, GF2 and WV3 can raise RR over the same-seed 88 K2D. Neither current value was chosen by comparison.
plan_context: 2026-11-19 user decision: single seed 42 + validation selection per stage, stacked on the previous stage; only the final model gets 3 seeds (issue 203). Test is measured and reported, never used to select or to decide whether to apply a change.
base_recipe: 88 K2D: full C2MS at constant lr 1e-4 for 120 epochs -> 83 K2 factorization -> 30-epoch cosine decay 1e-4 -> 1e-6 with a new Adam; same loss form, data, projection (86 FastProjectedV2 K10) and selection (minimum original-scale validation MSE over K2 epochs 0..30) as 88
loss: original per-pixel L1 + c x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + lambda x spectral loss (1 - cos) on the original pair

w2_check.change: W2 branch input PixelUnshuffle(2)+Conv2d(256,128,1) -> Conv2d(64,128,2,stride 2) (identical operation); output Conv2d(128,256,1)+PixelShuffle(2) -> 2x2 stride-2 transposed convolution 128->64, weight and bias zero-initialized (per-position bias 256 -> per-channel 64, 192 fewer parameters)
w2_check.output_implementation: ConvTranspose2d(128,64,2,2) vs Conv2d(128,256,1,bias=False) -> PixelShuffle(2) -> per-channel bias (64); timed with the 85 rule (official setting, autotune off) and the 86 graph_fp16 setting at 256^2 and 512^2 on an idle GPU after the 88 evaluation and before any 89 training; use the one that is at least 3% faster in both settings, otherwise ConvTranspose2d; record the float64 max difference between the two
w2_check.factorization_check: 83 targets() must not select the 2x2 input/output layers; the K2 model with the 2x2 implementation has exactly 192 fewer parameters than the original-implementation K2
w2_check.run: QB seed 42, lambda 0.46, c 1.0, 88 K2D recipe (TRUNK 120 + K2D 30)
w2_check.apply_rule: apply the 2x2 implementation if the original-scale validation PSNR difference (selected epoch, network output) is >= -0.06 dB; test RR with projection is measured and reported only
w2_check.with_screening: stages A and B use the 2x2 implementation from the start without waiting for the check; if it is not applied, only the confirmation runs use the original implementation and the limitation is reported
limits: initialization RNG consumption changes (seed noise mixed in)
parameter names differ from the 65/81/83/88 checkpoints

screening.schedule: epochs 1-40 lr 1e-4; epochs 41-50 cosine to 1e-6 (88 schedule shortened)
screening.selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE over epochs (earliest exact tie), as 88

stage_A.order: shared points first (GF2 6, WV3 6, QB 0/0.2/0.46/0.8/1.2/2.0), then the other 16 QB points

stage_B.reference_note: the (lambda*, 1.0) point is trained again in stage B and used as the stage-B reference; the difference to the stage-A run of the same setting is reported as rerun spread
stage_B.reduced_fallback: if the schedule is tight: c = 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 on all three sensors (15 runs); the QB moving average then uses the 0.5 grid with centers 0.5-1.5

selection_rule.metric: Delta_s(x) = original-scale validation PSNR of candidate x on sensor s minus that of the same-sensor reference point (network output, screening-selected epoch)
selection_rule.1_qb_moving_average: on the evenly spaced QB grid, m(x_i) = mean(Delta(x_{i-1}), Delta(x_i), Delta(x_{i+1})); x_QB = center with the largest m among center_candidates (ends excluded); lambda = 0.46 is off-grid and is only the stage-A reference
selection_rule.2_shared_check: p* = shared point with the largest three-sensor mean of Delta; if x_QB lies between the shared points adjacent to p* (inclusive; if p* is an end, between p* and its neighbor) choose x_QB, otherwise choose p*
selection_rule.3_sam_check: reject the choice if on any sensor where it was trained the validation SAM is worse than the reference by more than tau_s
selection_rule.tau_basis: 2 x sample std of the best-epoch validation SAM over the 65 seeds 42-44 (QB 0.0021, GF2 0.0020, WV3 0.0122 deg; n = 3, rough)
selection_rule.fallback_order: choice from 2 -> remaining QB centers inside the p* interval by m -> remaining shared points by three-sensor mean; first that passes 3; if none passes keep the reference (lambda 0.46 / c 1.0)
selection_rule.boundary: if the choice is at the edge of the range (centers 0.1/1.9 or 0.25/1.75, shared points 0/2.0) report that the optimum may lie outside; the range is not extended
selection_rule.c_zero: c = 0 is accepted if chosen; the report states that scale mixing is removed
selection_rule.test: test RR (with projection) measured for every candidate and tabulated, never used for selection
selection_rule.user_confirmation: lambda* and c* are reported (curves, choice, rule trace) and confirmed by the user before the next stage starts

screening_check.note: reference only, not used for selection
screening_check.compare: QB lambda=0 screening Delta vs 150-epoch cosine 63 (lambda 0) - 65 (lambda 0.46), seed 42: validation PSNR -0.029 dB, SAM +0.048 deg; only QB seed 42 exists at 150 epochs

confirmation.recipe: 88 K2D (150 epochs) with lambda*, c* and the W2 implementation from w2_check
confirmation.judgement: v2.4 RR test PSNR/SAM/ERGAS, single-seed threshold 0.06 dB (report); the confirmed model is the 203 base regardless of the judgement

transfer: WV2 transfer is not measured in this experiment

expected_gpu_hours.definition: sum of run wall times / 2 (two concurrent runs); 88 concurrent epoch times QB 134 s, GF2 156 s, WV3 about 98 s

next: issue 203: internal up/downsampling replacement on the confirmed model, then the final model with seeds 43 and 44
limits: single seed 42 per stage; the 3-seed judgement is done once on the final model
screening is a 50-epoch full-size run while the confirmation is K2D 150 epochs; the ranking may change
GF2 and WV3 points are sparse and only check the QB optimum interval
validation is network output without the projection; the confirmation and judgement use the projection
precision: FP16 AMP training with GradScaler; FP32 loss, validation and evaluation; factorization in float32 with float64 accumulation
ema_note: EMA recorded only (as 65); selection uses the online weights

latency.setting: one process, no training on the GPU, batch 1, test scene 0 (RR 256^2, FR 512^2), float32, TF32 off, cuDNN deterministic, autotune off, NCHW; 5 warm-up, 50 timed runs per system interleaved, 3 rounds, median of the round medians
latency.reference: cuDNN autotune + TF32 and FP16 autocast timings and the FP16 RR change (never a judgement)
